title: Hysab Kytab v1.0.8
message: Gemini-style Assistant bottom sheet overlay for Home button, full-speed in-app updates with instant package installer, and extended voice recognition.
changelog: Gemini AI floating bottom sheet popup for long-press Home button
Restored high-speed direct in-app downloading (reaches 100% in ~20s)
Direct native APK package installer launch (zero Sharing errors)
No more white Google dialog with generous speaking timeouts
Screen remains visible with translucent backdrop and quick expense chips
